app.description: Semantic chunking compatible with langchain-experimental's SemanticChunker. Embeddings given as 'hash' are a practice mock (word overlap, not meaning).
app.epilog: Exit codes: 0 ok / identical, 1 parity mismatch, 2 usage or config error, 3 legacy package not installed, 4 embedding backend unreachable.
cmd.split: Split files and print one JSON object per chunk.
cmd.explain: Show the distance bars, threshold and cuts for one file.
cmd.parity: Check that semsplit gives the same chunks as the original (or a recorded golden file).
arg.threshold: breakpoint threshold type: percentile, standard_deviation, interquartile, gradient
arg.amount: threshold amount (default depends on the type; percentile and gradient: 0-100)
arg.buffer_size: neighbour sentences added on each side before embedding
arg.min_chunk_size: merge pieces smaller than this many characters
arg.max_chunk_size: never emit chunks longer than this many characters (opt-in)
arg.text_mode: legacy (sentences joined by one space) or original (exact slices of the text)
arg.sentence_split: sentence splitter preset: default or cjk
arg.embed_batch_size: embed at most this many texts per call
arg.lang: screen language: en or ko (also SEMSPLIT_LANG)
arg.against: compare with the archived original (needs: pip install 'semsplit[legacy]')
arg.golden: compare with a golden file recorded earlier
arg.record: write a golden file (from the original with --against legacy, otherwise from semsplit)
arg.eps: a value within this distance of the threshold is reported as fragile
err.bad_nonneg_int: {value!r} must be 0 or a positive integer
err.not_finite: {value!r} must be a finite number (not nan or inf)
err.amount_range: --amount for --threshold {kind} must be between 0 and 100 (a percentile), got {value}
err.no_input: give at least one text file (or --golden FILE)
err.legacy_missing: the original langchain-experimental 0.4.2 is not installed. Install it with: pip install 'semsplit[legacy]'  (or run: uv run --extra legacy semsplit parity ...). To compare without it, use a recorded file: semsplit parity --golden FILE
err.lib.buffer_size: buffer_size must be an integer >= 0, got {value!r}.
err.lib.positive_int: {name} must be a positive integer or None, got {value!r}.
err.lib.max_lt_min: max_chunk_size ({max}) must not be smaller than min_chunk_size ({min}).
err.lib.length_function: length_function must be a callable str -> int.
err.lib.sentence_split_unknown: Unknown sentence_split {value!r}. Use 'default', 'cjk' or a callable.
err.lib.sentence_split_type: sentence_split must be 'default', 'cjk' or a callable.
err.lib.regex: sentence_split_regex is not a valid regex: {reason}.
err.lib.dim: dim must be a positive integer, got {value!r}.
err.lib.ollama_model: Ollama model name is empty. Use --embeddings ollama:<model>.
err.lib.ollama_unreachable: Could not get embeddings from Ollama at {host} ({reason}). Start the server (ollama serve), pull the model (ollama pull {model}) or set OLLAMA_HOST.
err.lib.ollama_reply: Unexpected reply from Ollama at {host}: expected {count} embeddings.
err.lib.golden_read: Cannot read golden file {path}: {reason}. Record one with --record.
err.lib.golden_format: {path} is not a semsplit golden file (format {format}).
err.lib.span_pair: sentence_split callback must return (start, end) pairs, got {item!r}.
err.lib.span_invalid: sentence_split callback returned an invalid span {item!r}: spans must be ordered, non-overlapping and inside the text (length {length}).
mock.note: note: embeddings=hash is a practice mock (word overlap, not meaning); use a real embedding model for real documents.
explain.legend: bar = distance to the next sentence, | = threshold
explain.legend_gradient: bar = distance to the next sentence; cuts compare the gradient column with the threshold
explain.too_short: not enough sentences to compare: nothing to cut ({count} sentence(s)).
parity.detail_boundaries: boundary positions only in the original: {old}; only in semsplit: {new}
parity.summary_ok: all {count} cases are identical ({fragile} fragile cut(s) reported)
